title: ResGVC: Residual Coding for High-fidelity Generative Video Compression
title_zh: ResGVC：用于高保真生成式视频压缩的残差编码

paragraphs.en: Generative video compression (GVC) methods usually employ decoder-side diffusion models to denoise reconstructed signals based on generative priors. Besides, most of these methods perform denoising in latent space rather than directly in pixel domain. In this paper, we propose ResGVC , a residual coding framework for GVC that guides denoising toward original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures within a learned video codec, and then decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments, where each residual segment is acquired at each denoising step. Residual segments can further be compressed by a novel residual codec with a diffusion transformer as an entropy model. Unlike prior methods, ResGVC introduces explicit source constraints throughout denoising rather than relying on decoder-side generation alone. The diffusion-based entropy model also enables more effective distribution modeling capability based on the powerful generative priors. Moreover, denoising directly in pixel space avoids the irreversible information loss caused by latent representation bottlenecks. Experimental results show that, compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, ResGVC achieves 63.7% and 83.8% BD-rate reductions in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, while also delivering superior visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式视频压缩（GVC）方法通常利用解码器端的扩散模型，基于生成先验对重建信号进行去噪。 此外，这些方法大多在潜在空间而非直接在像素域中进行去噪。 本文提出 ResGVC，一种面向 GVC 的残差编码框架，通过传输残差信号将去噪引导至原始图像。 ResGVC 首先使用学习型视频编解码器对原始图像进行编码，然后将编解码器重建结果与原始图像之间的失真分解为一系列残差片段，其中每个残差片段在每个去噪步骤中获得。 残差片段还可进一步由一种新型残差编解码器压缩，该编解码器以扩散 Transformer 作为熵模型。 与以往方法不同，ResGVC 在整个去噪过程中引入显式的信源约束，而不是仅依赖解码器端的生成。 基于扩散的熵模型还能依托强大的生成先验实现更有效的分布建模能力。 此外，直接在像素空间去噪避免了潜在表示瓶颈导致的不可逆信息损失。 实验结果表明，与之前的最先进方法相比，ResGVC 在 LPIPS 和 PSNR 上分别取得 63.7% 和 83.8% 的 BD-rate 降低，同时具有更优的视觉质量。

paragraphs.en: Traditional video coding standards ( Wiegand et al., 2003 ; Sullivan et al., 2012 ; Bross et al., 2021 ) and recent neural video compression (NVC) methods ( Li et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Jia et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026c ) have shown non-trivial improvements in rate-distortion performance. As the optimization prioritizes signal fidelity, these codecs may lose fine textures or produce blurry results at low bitrates, which deviates from human perception. This limitation has motivated generative video compression (GVC), where generative models are integrated into codecs to synthesize plausible details that are not explicitly transmitted. Recent GVC methods commonly employ decoder-side diffusion models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) to denoise reconstructed signals and improve perceptual quality ( Ma and Chen, 2025a ; Xue et al., 2026 ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026d ) . Moreover, most work performs denoising in latent space rather than directly in pixel domain.

paragraphs.en: However, in existing GVC methods, the decoder-side denoising process is largely driven by generative priors without sufficient source constraints along the denoising path. As a result, the denoised signal may drift from the original signal during iterative denoising. Besides, because these methods typically perform latent denoising coupled with latent autoencoders, the bottleneck discards fine details that cannot be reliably recovered at the decoder ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) . These limitations suggest that faithful GVC requires explicit source constraints throughout denoising and performs denoising directly in pixel space without relying on latent autoencoders.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在现有的 GVC 方法中，解码端的去噪过程主要由生成先验驱动，缺乏沿去噪路径的充分源约束。 因此，去噪后的信号可能在迭代去噪过程中偏离原始信号。 此外，由于这些方法通常在潜在空间中执行去噪并与潜在自编码器耦合，瓶颈会丢弃无法在解码端可靠恢复的细微细节（Kingma and Welling, 2013）。 这些局限表明，忠实的 GVC 需要在整个去噪过程中施加显式的源约束，并直接在像素空间中执行去噪，而不依赖潜在自编码器。

ResGVC first encodes the original pictures within a learned video codec, and then reformulates the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments. Each residual segment is acquired at each denoising step along a predefined denoising path at the encoder side. ResGVC selectively transmits fidelity-critical residual segments, which serve as source constraints for reconstructing the denoising path at the decoder side. paragraphs.en: For efficient residual coding, we propose a residual codec by extending a pixel-space video diffusion transformer from a generator to a conditional probability estimator. This diffusion model estimates the distribution of each residual segment, allowing fidelity-critical residual segments to be entropy-coded while predicting the remaining residual segments from the previously transmitted ones. Thus, residual coding is reserved for information that must be faithfully transmitted to preserve reconstruction quality, whereas residual generation is employed for content that can be well predicted by the generative model to reduce bitrate. By jointly applying residual coding and residual generation along the denoising path, ResGVC achieves an improved perception-fidelity-rate trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现高效的残差编码，我们通过将像素空间的视频扩散Transformer从生成器扩展为条件概率估计器，提出了一种残差编解码器。 该扩散模型估计每个残差片段的分布，使得对保真度至关重要的残差片段可以进行熵编码，同时从先前已传输的残差片段预测其余残差片段。 因此，残差编码被保留用于必须忠实传输以保持重建质量的信息，而残差生成则用于生成模型能够良好预测的内容，从而降低比特率。 通过沿去噪路径联合应用残差编码与残差生成，ResGVC 实现了更优的感知-保真度-码率权衡。

paragraphs.en: Generative video compression (GVC) incorporates generative models into codecs to improve perceptual quality beyond the signal-fidelity objective of traditional video coding and fidelity-oriented NVC. Early GVC methods ( Yang et al., 2022 ; Mentzer et al., 2022 ) mainly introduced generative adversarial networks (GANs) and perceptual losses into neural codecs. Although these methods improved perceptual realism, they often suffered from training instability and visual artifacts. Other work explored generative reconstruction on latent or tokenized representations. For example, GLC-Video ( Qi et al., 2025 ) performed compression in latent space of a vector-quantized variational autoencoder, while ProGVC ( Li et al., 2026b ) proposed a progressive generative codec based on hierarchical multi-scale residual token maps. However, these methods remained constrained by the representational capacity of their latent or tokenized bottlenecks.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式视频压缩（GVC）将生成模型引入编解码器，以超越传统视频编码和面向保真度的神经视频编码（NVC）的信号保真度目标，从而提升感知质量。 早期GVC方法（Yang et al., 2022；Mentzer et al., 2022）主要将生成对抗网络（GAN）和感知损失引入神经编解码器。 尽管这些方法提升了感知真实性，但常常存在训练不稳定和视觉伪影的问题。 另一些工作则探索了在潜在表示或词元化表示上的生成式重建。 例如，GLC-Video（Qi et al., 2025）在向量量化变分自编码器的潜在空间中进行压缩，而ProGVC（Li et al., 2026b）提出了一种基于层次化多尺度残差词元映射的渐进式生成编解码器。 然而，这些方法仍然受限于其潜在瓶颈或词元化瓶颈的表示能力。

sents.en: Generative video compression (GVC) incorporates generative models into codecs to improve perceptual quality beyond the signal-fidelity objective of traditional video coding and fidelity-oriented NVC.
sents.zh: 生成式视频压缩（GVC）将生成模型引入编解码器，以超越传统视频编码和面向保真度的神经视频编码（NVC）的信号保真度目标，从而提升感知质量。

sents.en: Early GVC methods ( Yang et al., 2022 ; Mentzer et al., 2022 ) mainly introduced generative adversarial networks (GANs) and perceptual losses into neural codecs.
sents.zh: 早期GVC方法（Yang et al., 2022；Mentzer et al., 2022）主要将生成对抗网络（GAN）和感知损失引入神经编解码器。

sents.en: Although these methods improved perceptual realism, they often suffered from training instability and visual artifacts.
sents.zh: 尽管这些方法提升了感知真实性，但常常存在训练不稳定和视觉伪影的问题。

sents.en: Other work explored generative reconstruction on latent or tokenized representations.
sents.zh: 另一些工作则探索了在潜在表示或词元化表示上的生成式重建。

sents.en: For example, GLC-Video ( Qi et al., 2025 ) performed compression in latent space of a vector-quantized variational autoencoder, while ProGVC ( Li et al., 2026b ) proposed a progressive generative codec based on hierarchical multi-scale residual token maps.
sents.zh: 例如，GLC-Video（Qi et al., 2025）在向量量化变分自编码器的潜在空间中进行压缩，而ProGVC（Li et al., 2026b）提出了一种基于层次化多尺度残差词元映射的渐进式生成编解码器。

sents.en: However, these methods remained constrained by the representational capacity of their latent or tokenized bottlenecks.
sents.zh: 然而，这些方法仍然受限于其潜在瓶颈或词元化瓶颈的表示能力。

paragraphs.en: Recently, emerging diffusion models provide strong generative priors for GVC due to their ability to synthesize realistic spatial and temporal details. Existing diffusion-based methods ( Ma and Chen, 2025a ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026d ; Li et al., 2026a ; Ma and Chen, 2025b ; Ma and Chen, 2026 ) typically adopt a latent compression pipeline, where the original video is encoded into a compact latent representation and a diffusion model is employed in the decoder to remove compression distortions from the decoded latent. DiffVC ( Ma and Chen, 2025a ) follows this paradigm by compressing videos in the latent domain and using an image diffusion model to enhance decoded latent frames. GNVC-VD ( Mao et al., 2026 ) further introduces a video diffusion transformer to jointly enhance decoded latent representations. YODA ( Li et al., 2026d ) explores one-step diffusion-based video compression by embedding multiscale temporal reference features for both latent coding and latent denoising.
paragraphs.zh: 近来，新兴的扩散模型凭借其合成逼真空间与时间细节的能力，为生成式视频压缩（GVC）提供了强大的生成先验。 现有的基于扩散的方法（ Ma and Chen, 2025a ； Mao et al., 2026 ； Li et al., 2026d ； Li et al., 2026a ； Ma and Chen, 2025b ； Ma and Chen, 2026 ）通常采用潜在压缩流水线，即将原始视频编码为紧凑的潜在表示，并在解码器中使用扩散模型来去除解码后的潜在表示中的压缩失真。 DiffVC（ Ma and Chen, 2025a ）遵循这一范式，在潜在域中对视频进行压缩，并使用图像扩散模型来增强解码后的潜在帧。 GNVC-VD（ Mao et al., 2026 ）进一步引入视频扩散 Transformer 来联合增强解码后的潜在表示。 YODA（ Li et al., 2026d ）通过在潜在编码和潜在去噪中嵌入多尺度时序参考特征，探索了基于一步扩散的视频压缩。

paragraphs.en: Despite their promising perceptual quality, these methods still primarily perform decoder-side denoising in latent space. Their denoising process is largely guided by generative priors, while explicit source constraints along the denoising path remain weak. Moreover, when built upon latent autoencoders, they inherit an irreversible reconstruction bottleneck that discards fine details. In contrast, our method introduces residual coding into pixel-space denoising, enabling explicit source constraints on the denoising process.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些方法具有良好的感知质量，但它们仍然主要在隐空间中执行解码端去噪。 它们的去噪过程主要由生成先验引导，而去噪路径上的显式源约束仍然较弱。 此外，当构建于隐自编码器之上时，它们继承了不可逆的重建瓶颈，会丢失精细细节。 相比之下，我们的方法将残差编码引入像素空间去噪，从而能够对去噪过程施加显式源约束。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have become a popular paradigm for visual generation because they progressively transform noisy samples into clean data using learned denoising dynamics ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Song et al., 2021a ; Song et al., 2021b ) . Recent work has developed diffusion architectures based on U-Net ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) and transformer ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) backbones for high-quality image and video generation ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Wan et al., 2025 ) . To improve efficiency, many methods ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) perform denoising in a compressed latent space which is produced by a variational autoencoder (VAE) ( Kingma and Welling, 2013 ) . While this design substantially reduces computation, it inherits the reconstruction bottleneck of the autoencoder. In contrast, pixel-space diffusion models directly denoise visual signals in the original signal space and can better preserve fine-grained details ( Li and He, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: In GVC, diffusion models using flow matching are mainly employed as decoder-side denoisers to refine reconstructed latent representations with generative priors ( Ma and Chen, 2025a ; Mao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026d ; Li et al., 2026a ; Ma and Chen, 2025b ) . Under this formulation, restoration can be considered as estimating a denoising path from the codec reconstruction toward the original pictures. Existing methods primarily predict the denoising path from generative priors, without sufficient source constraints. This motivates our design: instead of treating the denoising path as purely generative, we use transmitted residual signals to guide the denoising process, thereby constraining it with explicit source information. Moreover, unlike latent-space diffusion used in most prior methods, our approach performs denoising in pixel space without the latent representation bottleneck.

paragraphs.en: ResGVC represents a residual coding framework for high-fidelity GVC. It first compresses original pictures within a learned video codec ( Li et al., 2026c ) , and then refines the decoded pictures using residual information through iterative residual coding. The whole diffusion process is performed directly in pixel domain, avoiding the irreversible bottleneck of latent space. Concretely, the distortion between the decoded pictures and the original pictures is decomposed into a sequence of residual segments, each obtained at a denoising step. To encode these segments efficiently, we design a residual codec in which a pixel-space video diffusion model serves as a conditional probability estimator for entropy coding. Section 3.1 formulates the residual segments from the codec reconstruction to the original pictures. Section 3.2 presents the proposed residual codec and its diffusion-based entropy model. Section 3.3 describes a skip mode for residual coding, which skips residual coding at selected denoising steps and replaces it with decoder-side residual generation for reducing bitrate.
paragraphs.zh: ResGVP 代表一种面向高保真 GVC 的残差编码框架。 它首先在学习型视频编解码器（Li et al., 2026c）中压缩原始图片，然后通过迭代残差编码利用残差信息对解码图片进行细化。 整个扩散过程直接在像素域中进行，避免了潜在空间的不可逆瓶颈。 具体而言，解码图片与原始图片之间的失真被分解为一系列残差片段，每个片段在一个去噪步骤中获得。 为了高效编码这些片段，我们设计了一种残差编解码器，其中像素空间视频扩散模型充当熵编码的条件概率估计器。 第 3.1 节从编解码器重建到原始图片对残差片段进行了形式化定义。 第 3.2 节介绍了所提出的残差编解码器及其基于扩散的熵模型。 第 3.3 节描述了一种用于残差编码的跳过模式，该模式在选定的去噪步骤中跳过残差编码，并用解码器侧的残差生成来替代，以降低码率。

paragraphs.en: ResGVC supports a skip mode, in which residual coding is applied only to selected denoising steps. For the skipped steps, the corresponding residual segments are not transmitted but are instead generated at the decoder without incurring additional bitrate or quantization error, as illustrated in Fig. 4 . Specifically, each residual segment 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} can be recovered at the decoder in one of two modes: residual coding , in which 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} is reconstructed from the bitstream, and residual generation , in which 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} is predicted by the diffusion model, i.e. , VideoPiT. Residual coding is employed in the earlier denoising steps, which are more crucial to the final reconstruction quality, to faithfully transmit fidelity-critical residual segments. In the later steps, by leveraging the informative context from previously decoded residual signals, VideoPiT serves as a generator to estimate 𝝁 t \bm{\mu}_{t} and 𝝈 t \bm{\sigma}_{t} without bitstream constraints. The estimated 𝝁 t \bm{\mu}_{t} is directly used as the predicted 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} , while 𝝈 t \bm{\sigma}_{t} is discarded. Therefore, given a total of T T denoising steps, the number of residual-coding steps determines the trade-off between bitrate and reconstruction quality, and its effect is further analyzed in Section 4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: ResGVC 支持一种跳过模式，在该模式下，残差编码仅应用于选定的去噪步骤。 对于被跳过的步骤，相应的残差段不被传输，而是在解码端生成，不产生额外的码率或量化误差，如图 4 所示。 具体而言，每个残差段 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} 可以在解码端以两种模式之一恢复：残差编码，即 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} 从码流中重建；以及残差生成，即 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} 由扩散模型（即 VideoPiT）预测得到。 残差编码用于较早的去噪步骤，这些步骤对最终重建质量更为关键，以忠实地传输对保真度至关重要的残差段。 在较晚的步骤中，通过利用先前解码的残差信号所提供的信息上下文，VideoPiT 作为生成器来估计 𝝁 t \bm{\mu}_{t} 和 𝝈 t \bm{\sigma}_{t}，而不受码流约束。 估计得到的 𝝁 t \bm{\mu}_{t} 直接用作预测的 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t}，而 𝝈 t \bm{\sigma}_{t} 则被丢弃。 因此，在总共 T T 个去噪步骤中，残差编码步骤的数量决定了码率与重建质量之间的权衡，其影响将在 4.3 节中进一步分析。

paragraphs.en: Test details. We evaluate ResGVC on the HEVC B ( Sullivan et al., 2012 ) , UVG ( Mercat et al., 2020 ) , and MCL-JCV ( Wang et al., 2016 ) datasets. Following ( Li et al., 2023 ; Mao et al., 2026 ) , raw YUV420 videos are converted to RGB using BT.709 ( Li et al., 2023 ) , and the first 96 frames of each sequence are used for evaluation. Compression performance is measured by BD-rate and BD-metric ( Bjontegaard, 2001 ) . Signal fidelity is measured by PSNR and MS-SSIM ( Wang et al., 2003 ) . Perceptual quality is assessed by LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) and DISTS ( Ding et al., 2020 ) . To assess temporal perceptual consistency, we report FloLPIPS ( Danier et al., 2022 ) , a flow-guided LPIPS variant. Generative realism is measured by FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , following ( Mentzer et al., 2020 ) . Bitrate is reported in bits per pixel (BPP). ResGVC is evaluated with intra-period = -1 and GOP size = 8. Since ResGVC is trained with five denoising steps, we use two steps for residual coding and three steps for residual generation during testing, which gives the best overall compression performance. Analysis of this setting is provided in Section 4.3 .

paragraphs.en: Baselines. We compare ResGVC with three categories of baselines: 1) the traditional video codec VTM-17.0 ( Bross et al., 2021 ) ; 2) the fidelity-oriented NVC method DCVC-FM ( Li et al., 2024 ) ; and 3) GVC methods, including PLVC ( Yang et al., 2022 ) , GLC-Video ( Qi et al., 2025 ) , DiffVC ( Ma and Chen, 2025a ) , GNVC-VD ( Mao et al., 2026 ) , and YODA ( Li et al., 2026d ) . For VTM-17.0, we follow the evaluation protocol from Li et al. (2023) . Since the code for DiffVC and GNVC-VD is publicly unavailable, we report the results from their original papers. Other baselines are tested with their default settings. We use the latest open-source method YODA as the anchor for BD-rate computation, rather than VTM-17.0 as usual, because the RD curves of VTM-17.0 are often far from those of GVC methods and overlap only marginally in quality range.

paragraphs.en: The proposed ResGVC outperforms all baselines on most perceptual metrics, achieving notably lower LPIPS and FID at comparable bitrates. Table 1 summarizes the BD-rate and BD-metric results. Averaged over the three test sets, ResGVC achieves bitrate savings of 63.7% in LPIPS, 21.2% in DISTS, 67.2% in FID, and 26.1% in FloLPIPS relative to the second-best method YODA. Additionally, as shown in Fig. 6 , ResGVC delivers the best PSNR and MS-SSIM performance among all GVC methods, and is even comparable to the fidelity-oriented NVC method DCVC-FM at low bitrates. Notably, on the HEVC B test set, ResGVC surpasses DCVC-FM in MS-SSIM when the bitrate is below 0.005 BPP. Detailed BD-rate and BD-metric results for PSNR and MS-SSIM are provided in the appendix. Overall, these results show that ResGVC advances both perceptual quality and signal fidelity over previous GVC methods.

paragraphs.en: Qualitative comparisons. Fig. 7 presents a visual comparison of different methods. Owing to its optimization objective that prioritizes signal fidelity, DCVC-FM tends to produce blurred regions and fails to preserve fine-grained textures and structural details. Although GVC methods such as GLC-Video and YODA achieve higher perceptual quality than DCVC-FM, they often introduce spatial inconsistencies and hallucinated details, reflecting an overemphasis on perceptual quality at the expense of signal fidelity. By contrast, ResGVC more faithfully preserves object structures while maintaining rich textural details. These observations further suggest that, for GVC methods, signal fidelity should not be neglected when optimizing perceptual quality; otherwise, noticeable visual degradation and structural collapse may occur.

paragraphs.en: Complexity comparisons. We compare the per-frame encoding and decoding times of ResGVC with those of two recent methods, i.e. , GNVC-VD and YODA. Among the GVC baselines, GNVC-VD delivers superior compression performance on fidelity-oriented metrics, whereas YODA excels on perceptual metrics. Since the official implementation of GNVC-VD is unavailable, we reproduce its model architecture solely for complexity evaluation, without training. As presented in Table 3 , ResGVC is faster than GNVC-VD in both encoding and decoding, mainly because GNVC-VD has a substantially larger model size. Compared with YODA, which uses single-step denoising, ResGVC has a slightly slower decoding speed due to its five-step denoising design. However, the compact model size of ResGVC helps offset the overhead introduced by the additional denoising steps, allowing it to maintain competitive decoding speed. Despite using fewer parameters, ResGVC still outperforms YODA in both perceptual quality and signal fidelity, further demonstrating the effectiveness of our pixel-space residual coding framework.
paragraphs.zh: 复杂度对比。 我们将 ResGVC 的单帧编码与解码时间与两种近期方法（即 GNVC-VD 和 YODA）进行比较。 在 GVC 基线中，GNVC-VD 在面向保真度的指标上具有更优的压缩性能，而 YODA 在感知指标上表现出色。 由于 GNVC-VD 的官方实现不可用，我们仅为其复现了模型架构以进行复杂度评估，未进行训练。 如表 3 所示，ResGVC 在编码和解码方面都比 GNVC-VD 更快，主要原因是 GNVC-VD 的模型规模要大得多。 与采用单步去噪的 YODA 相比，ResGVC 由于采用五步去噪设计，解码速度稍慢。 然而，ResGVC 紧凑的模型规模有助于抵消额外去噪步骤带来的开销，使其能够保持有竞争力的解码速度。 尽管参数量更少，ResGVC 在感知质量和信号保真度方面仍优于 YODA，进一步证明了我们的像素空间残差编码框架的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Effect of pixel-space residual coding. ResGVC performs residual coding directly in pixel space. To validate this design, we conduct the ablations in Table 3 , using the variant with five-step pixel-space residual coding as the anchor. Removing residual coding causes a substantial performance degradation, which confirms the necessity of residual coding. We then shift residual coding from pixel space to latent space by inserting ResGVC between the VAE encoder and decoder of Wan2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) , whose implementation details are provided in the appendix. This variant incurs 17.4% and 28.6% BD-rate losses in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, demonstrating that residual coding is more effective in pixel space than in latent space.
paragraphs.zh: 像素空间残差编码的效果。 ResGVC 直接在像素空间执行残差编码。 为验证该设计，我们在表 3 中进行了消融实验，以五步像素空间残差编码的变体作为基准。 移除残差编码会导致显著的性能下降，这证实了残差编码的必要性。 随后，我们通过在 Wan2.1 的 VAE 编码器与解码器之间插入 ResGVC，将残差编码从像素空间转移到潜空间，其实现细节见附录。 该变体在 LPIPS 和 PSNR 上分别产生 17.4% 和 28.6% 的 BD-rate 损失，表明残差编码在像素空间中比在潜空间中更为有效。

paragraphs.en: Effect of diffusion-based entropy model. Existing fidelity-oriented NVC and GVC methods typically rely on CNN-based entropy models to estimate the distributions used for entropy coding. In contrast, ResGVC adopts a diffusion-based entropy model, which leverages stronger generative priors for more accurate conditional probability estimation. As shown in Table 3 , replacing our entropy model with the latest CNN-based design ( Li et al., 2026c ) degrades performance across all metrics, confirming the advantage of the diffusion-based entropy model for residual coding.

paragraphs.en: Effect of the skip mode for residual coding. In ResGVC, residual coding can be skipped at selected denoising steps, where residual segments are instead generated at the decoder by the diffusion model. This skip mode enables flexible switching between residual coding and residual generation at different denoising steps to optimize rate-distortion performance. As presented in Table 4 , we fix the total number of denoising steps to five and vary the number of residual-coding steps from zero to five, with the remaining steps handled by residual generation. The best performance is achieved with two coding steps and three generation steps, indicating that the most fidelity-critical residual segments are transmitted in the first two steps. Using more coding steps degrades performance by spending additional bitrate on residuals that can be reliably predicted from generative priors at the decoder, while using fewer coding steps weakens source constraints and thus reduces reconstruction quality.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present ResGVC, a residual coding framework for generative video compression that guides diffusion denoising toward the original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures with a learned video codec, and then decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments over denoising steps. These residual segments can further by compressed by a novel residual codec with a diffusion transformer as an entropy model, enabling explicit source constraints to be introduced throughout denoising rather than relying on decoder-side generation alone. By denoising directly in pixel space, ResGVC also avoids the irreversible information loss caused by latent representation bottlenecks. Experimental results demonstrate that ResGVC achieves state-of-the-art compression performance, reducing BD-rate by 63.7% in LPIPS and 83.8% in PSNR compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, while also delivering superior visual quality.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 ResGVC，一种面向生成式视频压缩的残差编码框架，通过传输残差信号引导扩散去噪趋向原始图像。 ResGVC 首先使用学习型视频编解码器对原始图像进行编码，然后将编解码器重建结果与原始图像之间的失真分解为去噪步骤上的残差片段序列。 这些残差片段可以进一步由一种新颖的残差编解码器压缩，该编解码器以扩散 Transformer 作为熵模型，从而在整个去噪过程中引入显式的源约束，而不仅依赖解码器侧的生成。 通过直接在像素空间中去噪，ResGVC 还避免了由潜在表示瓶颈导致的不可逆信息损失。 实验结果表明，ResGVC 实现了最先进的压缩性能，与之前最先进的方法相比，LPIPS 上降低了 63.7% 的 BD-rate，PSNR 上降低了 83.8% 的 BD-rate，同时还带来了更优的视觉质量。

The proposed residual codec employs analysis transform g a g_{\mathrm{a}} and synthesis transform g s g_{\mathrm{s}} to reduce the redundancy within each residual segment. g a g_{\mathrm{a}} and g s g_{\mathrm{s}} are built upon the encoder and decoder architecture of the inter model in DCVC-UF HT-L ( Li et al., 2026c ) , with two principal distinctions. First, our g a g_{\mathrm{a}} and g s g_{\mathrm{s}} are shared by both intra-coding and inter-coding, with the adapter introduced for the intra-frame to align the input channels of g a g_{\mathrm{a}} . By contrast, DCVC-UF employs two separate models for intra- and inter-coding. Second, we employ the previously reconstructed GOP 𝐱 ^ 0 p \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{0}^{\mathrm{p}} as condition information, whereas DCVC-UF relies on memory updated using features from decoded frames.

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-based Entropy Model. In our framework, the video pixel diffusion transformer (VideoPiT) serves as an entropy model, in which each PiT block is built upon the T2I variant of PixelDiT ( Yu et al., 2026 ) . We employ the previously reconstructed GOP 𝐱 ^ 0 p \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{0}^{\mathrm{p}} as the conditioning input, whereas PixelDiT conditions on features derived from the text embedding. In VideoPiT, the input 𝐱 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{t} first undergoes 16 × 16 16\times 16 patchification, followed by six PiT blocks. The output feature of the final PiT block is linearly projected to produce the probability parameters 𝝁 t \bm{\mu}_{t} and 𝝈 t \bm{\sigma}_{t} for entropy coding. Notably, both 𝝁 t \bm{\mu}_{t} and 𝝈 t \bm{\sigma}_{t} have spatial dimensions downsampled by a factor of 16 relative to 𝐱 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{x}}_{t} .

paragraphs.en: Following ( Mao et al., 2026 ) , we adopt the VAE from Wan2.1 ( Wan et al., 2025 ) as the autoencoder, which performs 8 × 8\times spatial downsampling for all frames and 4 × 4\times temporal downsampling for inter-frames only. As described in Section 3.2 , g a g_{\mathrm{a}} transforms the to-be-encoded 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} into 𝐲 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{y}}_{t} for subsequent entropy coding. The spatial resolution of 𝐲 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{y}}_{t} is reduced by a factor of 16 relative to 𝐑 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{R}}_{t} through an 8 × 8 8\times 8 patchification and a convolutional layer with 2 × 2\times downsampling within g a g_{\mathrm{a}} . To shift ResGVC to latent space, we encode two latent frames into 𝐲 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{y}}_{t} , corresponding to eight frames as a GOP in pixel space, and remove the patchification to ensure that 𝐲 ^ t \hat{\mathbf{y}}_{t} retains the same dimensions as in pixel-space residual coding. Besides, 16 × 16 16\times 16 patchification in the VideoPiT is replaced with 2 × 2 2\times 2 patchification.

paragraphs.en: We provide additional experimental results in Table 6 to evaluate the effectiveness of performing residual coding and residual generation in latent space vs. pixel space. A comparison between line (a) and line (b) shows that when five-step residual coding is performed in latent space, compression performance declines, particularly in terms of BD-rate w.r.t. PSNR. By contrast, comparing line (c) with line (d), the latent-space variant outperforms the pixel-space counterpart on perceptual metrics, i.e. , LPIPS, DISTS, and FloLPIPS. This may indicate that under a fixed model capacity, compact residual latent representations are more amenable to generation than pixel-space signals. Comparing line (a) with line (c), both of which operate in latent space, residual generation proves considerably more tractable than residual coding. This might be because compact latent representations are more susceptible to quantization, while quantization errors in latent space may be magnified in pixel space by the VAE decoder. Overall, as evidenced by the comparison between line (e) and line (f), the pixel-space model surpasses the latent-space model under our default setting of two-step coding and three-step generation.

paragraphs.en: We present additional qualitative comparisons on three datasets: HEVC B, MCL-JCV, and UVG. As illustrated in Fig. 9 - Fig. 11 , our method yields visually sharper and more realistic reconstructions than the competing baselines. Fig. 12 presents a comparison of temporal consistency across different methods. DCVC-FM generally produces blurry reconstructions, while GLC-Video and YODA tend to introduce jitter and flickering artifacts, thereby compromising temporal coherence. By contrast, our method delivers temporally stable reconstructions, especially in regions containing dense textures. These examples further underscore that our approach excels not only on quantitative metrics but also in preserving fine textures, realistic details, and perceptual naturalness, thereby delivering superior visual quality.
